name: Seagate Technology
legalName: Seagate Technology Holdings public limited company
description: Seagate makes hard disk drives (HDDs) and some storage systems. Its customers are hyperscale cloud companies, enterprises and PC/device makers (80 percent of revenue is sold to OEMs, including cloud builders), plus distributors and retailers. Its portfolio is split into Data Center (high-capacity HDDs up to 44TB and storage systems up to 3.5PB, built on its Mozaic HAMR heat-assisted recording platform) and Edge IoT (1TB to 32TB drives), and revenue rose 34 percent in fiscal 2026 from more nearline exabytes shipped and pricing actions, lifting gross margin from 35 to 46 percent. It competes with Western Digital and Toshiba in HDDs and with NAND flash makers.
